programme.desc: Kidnapers stalk Sammy Davis Jr., so Sabrina, Kelly and Kris are hired to protect him in "The Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper," guest starring Sammy Davis Jr. in twin roles as himself and as a guy who looks just like him, on "Charlie's Angels." The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious "demonstration" of his talent. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to \avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' "Hermosa Cup" tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents" leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Suspicious" is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their "Celestial Research Foundation," in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the "doctor" tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels must carry out an unusual assignment: three men have stolen a sack of rubies, and when one of them, Murdoch, double-crosses his two partners by escaping with the rubies, the other two hire the Angels to recover the missing jewels. The Angels are not "hired" exactly; Sabrina is forced to put on a belt loaded with explosives, and if the rubies are not recovered within twelve hours, the belt will set off by remote control. The designer of this belt is the one who masterminded the jewel theft, a psychotic electronics wizard named Dinsmore. From the crazy look in his eye, the Angels decide they better do as he says, so Kris and Kelly go out looking for Murdoch. Since Dinsmore shot him in the back as he was running away, they check the hospital first , but after the bullet was removed, Murdoch left in a hurry in order to sell the rubies. Charlie locates two men who helped the crooks steal the gems and who may be of use, if they can be forced to talk. Kris and Kelly leave these two locked in a bathroom naked after getting the information they need, and continue their search. By some excellent acting over the phone, Sabrina makes Dinsmore think that Kris has run off with Murdoch and the rubies, so he and Sabrina head for the airport to stop them. It is part of an elaborate plan to separate Dinsmore from the belt-exploding device, and it calls for Sabrina to dive into a puddle of muddy water where the radio signal won't reach the belt. At least she hopes it doesn't! Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Freddie the Fox" Brander is retired, but thirty years ago he was the world's greatest thief. Still dignified and charming as in days of old, he is disturbed in his retirement by two former crime partners who are sure that Freddie has the famous "Light of Arabia" diamond. They are preparing to torture him into revealing where it is, but Freddie escapes and goes straight to Charlie's Angels for help. He knows that the diamond is in the possession of oil sheik Faris Salim, who keeps it in his extremely well-guarded Caribbean estate. Freddie's plan is for the Angels to assist him in stealing the diamond once again, so that he can return it to the museum, and retire from crime forever. The Angels eagerly accept the job, and assume new identities for the Caribbean caper. Freddie and Sabrina become Lord and Lady Brander, with Bosley as their butler and Kelly as their private secretary. Kris pretends to be a racing car enthusiast in order to win the attention of Ali, Salim's mechanic-minded son. The idea is for everyone to get invited to Salim's birthday party, and once in the house, learn where the diamond is kept so Freddie can decide how to steal it. Since Salim has an affinity for nobility, invitations are not difficult to obtain. At the party, while Sabrina snaps pictures from a secret camera planted in her jeweled pin, Salim decides to show off his prize diamond, which is, indeed, guarded securely. the entire floor is electrified, ands as deadly snake hovers over the jewel. Sabrina pretends to 'faint' upon seeing the snake, and Kelly makes a wax impression of the lock to the only window in the room. This, with the secret photos, provides Freddie with all he needs to engineer the theft. A little help from Ali is needed at last minute -- he never did like his father very much. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels have never played football before, but that changes quickly when Amy Jarvis and her father Dan come to them for help. The Jarvis' football team, all women, has a big game scheduled against Julia Smyth's Panthers, but a pair of motorcycle riders has been terrorizing Amy and warning her not to play. Joining the team is only a cover, but Sabrina displays such good form that Julia Smyth invites her to play for the Panthers. Julia's only concern is winning, and her players are rough and well trained. More interestingly to Sabrina, Julia rides a motorcycle. But whether or not the Angels solve the mystery, Sabrina is so disgusted by Julia's "win-at-any-cost" attitude that she is determined to help Amy's team defeat the Panthers. Kelly meets a sad person named Joe Phillips in the parking lot, and they go out for dinner. Joe is a former football star whose injured knee forced him to retire, and now he feels like only half a man. Joe does not seem involved with the recent trouble, and Kelly grows tired of hearing how sad his life is. By locating all the local dealers who sell a certain kind of motorcycle, the Angels find the two that were used to scare the players, and driving away in a truck is none other than Joe Phillips. Furthermore he has taken blueprints of the stadium with him, as though he needed to know how to gain entry into rooms that would be locked, like the room where the stadium's safe is kept. Down on the field, Sabrina realizes that one of her teammates is Julia's spy and is secretly telling the Panthers what plays to expect. Using this knowledge, Sabrina outsmarts the cheaters, by calling one play and then running a different one. Catching crooks is the Angels' job, but winning this game is very satisfying. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosle

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris stalk the sands of Malibu Beach to track down the surfside killer of several young women in "Sandcastles Murders." Police have virtually no leads in their investigation of the "Sandcastle Murders." When one of the victims turns out to be a personal friend of Kris, boss Charlie give the girls permission to handle their own investigation. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Stunned by the mysterious death of his favorite folk-rock singer, Charlie sends Kelly, Kris and Sabrina to find everyone who spent time with the victim the night she pied in "Angel Blues." Amy Waters is one of the most popular singers in the country. Shortly after freaking out during a concert performance, Amy calls her dad to say she's coming home by cab to "get straight." But Amy makes a few stops along the way. One of the last people to see her alive is Lenny, the taxi driver Kris becomes acquainted with during the investigation. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.sub-title: Mother Goose Is Running For His Life
programme.desc: Leland Swinnerton, 70-year-old president of a huge toy corporation, is known to everyone as Mother Goose. He goes to Charlie's Angels for assistance when someone tries to sabotage the company toys by blowing up the corporate offices, causing at least one death. Sabrina, posing as a secretary from Hong Kong, becomes friendly with Gordon Roclair, the brilliant but crazy design director. Roclair confides to Sabrina that he hates Mother Goose, and is working for Tony Phelan, a gangster with plans to gain control of the company. With Sabrina tagging along as "partner," Roclair installs secret microphones around the factory, so that Phelan can hear all the latest corporate decisions. It is a simple matter for the Angels to sabotage the saboteurs by changing the location of the microphones. Instead of picking up important conversations in Mother Goose's office, Phelan hears the secretary talking about her flowers. By planing a microphone of their own in Phelan's truck, the Angels pick up all the wire tap communications and hear the gangsters' plans. This mike is especially useful when Phelan's accomplice, Orwell, discovers the identity of Kelly, who had been working with him as a "bugging expert." Orwell forces Kelly at gunpoint to drive the truck into the country, but Bosley and Kris are right behind, listening to every word. In the end, Roclair and Phelan are completely confused. Roclair finds Mother Goose's secret plans for the new Christmas toys with Sabrina's help, but Kris switches them for a set of useless vacuum cleaner blueprints. Phelan and his hoods chase Roclair, believing he doublecrossed them. In the confusion, a booby--trapped toy cannon in the factory shoots at Roclair and he falls, only from fright, because Kris had stopped up the barrel with bubblegum. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their in

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When two blonde "call girls" are brutally murdered in Mrs. Dolly Smith's apartment building, Kelly and Kris reluctantly go undercover as prostitutes and move into Mrs. Smith's establishment. On their first day at work, the trio arouses suspicion with their clever tactics to avoid meeting with "customers." But the Angels are more interested in the Italian restaurant across the street, where Freddie, the macho delivery boy works. He brings pizza to the girls in the building almost every day, and always acts aggressive and threatening. Then Bonnie, another blond girl, is attacked but manages to escape. When she says her assailant smelled like a restaurant, it looks like Freddie is the man. Freddie swears he's innocent, and when his shark's tooth pendant is found beside the latest victim, Sabrina wonders if it isn't a bit too obvious a clue. The owner of the Italian restaurant, Roman Vail, also has access to the apartment building, and the. Angels are surprised to learn that he knows Freddie lost his pendant. Also the last victim died with bits of skin under her fingernails, and Vail's arms show many scratch marks. When Sabrina and Kelly finally put the evidence together, they must rush to rescue blond-haired Kris who is alone in the restaurant with Vail. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie uses the Angels plus his own priceless collection of jade as bait to trip up an acrobatic jewel thief and a killer in "THE JADE TRAP." Gigolo Denny Railsback murders wealthy Julie Redmond when she becomes disenchanted. As Denny is doing away with Julie in the living room, cat burglar Ted Machlin is in the bedroom stealing jewels. When Denny spots Ted, he makes it appear that the jewel thief is the murderer. The setting is a posh residential hotel into which Kelly checks as a lonely heiress, Kris as a Swedish movie star and Bosley as a flamboyant auctioneer. Sabrina does her sleuthing as a hotel employee. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie; an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David-Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

The Jarvis' football team, all women, has a big game scheduled against Julia Smyth's Panthers, but a pair of motorcycle riders has been terrorizing Amy and warning her not to play. Joining the team is only a cover, but Sabrina displays such good form that Julia Smyth invites her to play for the Panthers. Julia's only concern is winning, and her players are rough and well trained. More interestingly to Sabrina, Julia rides a motorcycle. But whether or not the Angels solve the mystery, Sabrina is so disgusted by Julia's "win-at-any-cost" attitude that she is determined to help Amy's team defeat the Panthers. Kelly meets a sad person named Joe Phillips in the parking lot, and they go out for dinner. Joe is a former football star whose injured knee forced him to retire, and now he feels like only half a man. Joe does not seem involved with the recent trouble, and Kelly grows tired of hearing how sad his life is. By locating all the local dealers who sell a certain kind of motorcycle, the Angels find the two that were used to scare the players, and driving away in a truck is none other than Joe Phillips. Furthermore he has taken blueprints of the stadium with him, as though he needed to know how to gain entry into rooms that would be locked, like the room where the stadium's safe is kept. Down on the field, Sabrina realizes that one of her teammates is Julia's spy and is secretly telling the Panthers what plays to expect. Using this knowledge, Sabrina outsmarts the cheaters, by calling one play and then running a different one. Catching crooks is the Angels' job, but winning this game is very satisfying. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosle

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris stalk the sands of Malibu Beach to track down the surfside killer of several young women in "Sandcastles Murders." Police have virtually no leads in their investigation of the "Sandcastle Murders." When one of the victims turns out to be a personal friend of Kris, boss Charlie give the girls permission to handle their own investigation. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros

programme.title: The Hills: Meet The Parents
programme.desc: Ifølge mig: et komisk twist på din yndlings reality-serie. Fra Lauren til Spencer og alle de andre, intet bitchy look eller bromance udelades af skuespilleren, der spilleralle de medvirkende.

programme.title: The Hills: Rolling With The Enemy
programme.desc: Heidis sociale omgangskreds krymper da Spencer 'slår op' med Brody fordi han har hængt ud med Lauren. Audrina vil være fast kæreste med Justin, men det nægter han at gå med til.

programme.title: The Hills: Second Chances
programme.desc: Lauren bliver ringet op af en ekskæreste. Heidi konkurrerer med sin kollega Elodie om at blive forfremmet på arbejdet.

programme.title: The Hills: They Meet Again
programme.desc: Laurens følelser for Jason blusser op, men da de løber ind i Heidi og Spencer på en restaurant går bølgerne højt. Heidis forfremmelse hos Bolthouse koster hendes venskab med Elodie.

programme.title: The Hills: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Lauren bliver chokeret da hun hører, at Jason har en kæreste, men Jason har en endnu større overraskelse oppe i ærmet. Heidi finder ud af at Spencer ikke har fortalt sine forældre om deres bryllupsplaner.

programme.title: The Hills: What Happens In Vegas...
programme.desc: Hele slænget fejrer Brodys fødselsdag i Vegas. Audrinas kæreste Justin skaber splid i venskabet med Lauren. Lauren og Brodys tiltrækkes mere og mere af hinanden.

programme.title: The Hills: What Goes Around
programme.desc: Jen Bunney fortæller Lauren, at Brody startede rygterne om hende, mens Brody siger, at det var Spencer, hvilket bringer Heidi i en svær situation.

programme.title: The Hills: No More Mr. Nice Guy
programme.desc: Lauren indleder et nyt forhold med en model, men indser, at hun stadig har følelser for Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Stress And The City
programme.desc: Whitney og Lauren tager en tur til New York NYC for Teen Vogue og Spencer kontakter Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Young Hollywood
programme.desc: Whitney og Lauren er til Young Hollywood Party og Heidi fejrer sin 21. fødselsdag.

programme.title: The Hills: Forgive and Forget
programme.desc: Heidi og Lauren skændes endnu engang offentligt, hvilket får Heidi til at undskylde for alt det, der er sket. Og der er problemer i Audrina og Justins forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leger Kirsten Giftekniv, da Whitney skal ud på sin første date med deres personlige træner. Og Spencer modsætter sig Heidis ønsker om et eventyrbryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina ser Justin kysse med en anden pige, hvilket fører til endnu et kæmpeskænderi. Heidi er chokeret, da Stephanie skændes med Lauren og Brody på en natklub.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror, at Brody måske er for meget playboy for hende. Spencers søster fortæller hende, at Heidi er i tvivl om deres bryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får en god nyhed til Teen Vogue og Heidi har brug for noget tid væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer endelig af sted til Paris, men turen bliver næsten ødelagt da hun finder ud af, at Brody har fundet en anden. Spencer følger Heidi til Colorado for at prøve at vinde hende tilbage, men hans plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney må vælge mellem Teen Vogue og risikoen forbundet med at gå efter en ny karriere. Lauren og Brody skændes over hans nye kæreste og Heidi vænner sig til livet uden Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en uventet ven, da Spencers søster, Stephanie, går til de samme timer som hende. Whitney tror, at hendes nye job vil opfylde alle hendes drømme.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: Da Lauren inviterer Stephanie til hendes fødselsdag, får det Heidi og Spencer til at tvivle på Stephanies loyalitet. Spencer forsøger at vinde Heidi tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi prøver at vinde Audrinas venskab tilbage, men Lauren tvivler på Heidis motiver. Whitney er ved at vænne sig til sit nye job, men savner stadig at arbejde sammen med Lauren.

programme.desc: Heidi elsker at være single, men da hun ser Spencer sammen med andre piger bliver hun jaloux. Whitney beder om Laurens hjælp til modeugen i LA.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1312
programme.desc: Selvom man bor småt, kan man godt invitere til middagsselskab. Det beviser radio- og tv-vært Helin Erdem, når hun inviterer sine gæster med til sit elskede Albertslund.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1313

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1314
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Sille Nimholm inviterer indenfor i sit hjem i Albertslund, men ikke alle er imponeret over smagen. Værten åbner til gengæld op omkring retssager, og hvordan hun holder humøret oppe.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1315
programme.desc: TV-kendissen Linse Kessler byder på middag på sin elskede Bryggen, Islands Brygge i København. Her er plads til latter og sang, men med Linses nuværende økonomi er der ikke plads til meget mere.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1316
programme.desc: Politikeren Sikandar Siddique byder sine gæster indenfor til en oplevelse, der giver gæsterne et indblik i sin baggrund, og vi er med når Sikandar åbner op om en yderst svær periode i sit liv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Gustav Salinas byder indenfor i sin eksklusive lejlighed. Værten byder på mad fra varme lande, og lukker sine farvestrålende gæster indenfor i sit svære kærlighedsliv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1302

programme.desc: Der bliver budt på en rørende aften, når kendisfrisør Dennis Knudsen byder indenfor i sin luksusvilla i Korsør. Han lover mad på max 20 minutter - men mon det virkelig kan lade sig gøre uden hjælp?

programme.title: Simpsons
programme.desc: Som vinder af 2019 Emmy® Award-prisen for fremragende, animeret program fortsætter The Simpsons med at vække genklang hos seere for uærbødigt at lave sjov med alt og alle. Med dens yderliggående humor og herlige vid har serien gjort et uudsletteligt indtryk på amerikansk popkultur, og dets familiemedlemmer: Homer (Dan Castellaneta), Marge (Julie Kavner), Bart (Nancy Cartwright), Lisa (Yeardley Smith) og Maggie: er tv-ikoner. Som den længst kørende, nedskrevne serie i tv-historien har den Emmy® Award-, Annie Award- og Peabody Award-vindende, animerede komedie overgået Gunsmokes rekord for flest episoder af en nedskrevet, primetime tv-serie. The Simpsons er en Gracie Films produktion i samarbejde med 20th Century Fox Television. Serien blev skabt af Matt Groening og udviklet af James L. Brooks, Matt Groening og Sam Simon. James L. Brooks og Matt Groening er executive producere. Al Jean og Matt Selman er også executive producere og seriens showrunners.
